chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Shu'ayb, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamza who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: God, Blessed and Exalted, said: 'The completion of My proof against the wretched ones of your community is due to their abandonment of the wilaya of Ali and the successors after you, for in them is your sunnah and the sunnah of the Prophets before you, and they are My treasurers over My knowledge after you.'
Then the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Indeed, Jibrail (peace be upon him) has informed me of their names and the names of their forefathers.'

key_terms.اسْتِكْمَالُ حُجَّتِي: Completion of My proof/argument — in Islamic theology, hujja refers to God's authoritative proof; its completion means no excuse remains for disobedience
key_terms.الْأَشْقِيَاءِ: The wretched ones — those destined for misery due to their rejection of divine guidance
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: The successors/legatees — the Imams who come after the Prophet as divinely-appointed custodians
key_terms.خُزَّانِي: My treasurers/custodians — the Imams as guardians of the divine treasury of knowledge
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ عَلِيٍّ: Wilaya of Ali — the divinely-ordained guardianship and authority of Imam Ali (AS)

ai.seo_question: Why is the wilaya of Ali and the Imams obligatory according to Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) narrates a hadith qudsi in which God declared to the Prophet that those who abandon the wilaya (divinely-ordained guardianship) of Imam Ali and the subsequent Imams have no excuse — God's proof against them is complete. The Imams are described as the custodians of God's knowledge after the Prophet, bearing the sunnah of all prophets. The Prophet then affirms this divine appointment by stating that Jibrail himself revealed to him the names and lineages of these Imams, underscoring that their succession was not a human political decision but a divine covenant established before the Prophet's death.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Al Nazar Bin Shuayb, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High Said: “I<sup>azwj</sup> Completed My<sup>azwj</sup> Proof upon the wretched ones of your<sup>saww</sup> Community of the neglecting of the Wilayah of Ali<sup>asws</sup> and the successors<sup>asws</sup> from after you<sup>saww</sup>, in them<sup>asws</sup> is your<sup>saww</sup> Sunnah and the Sunnah of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> from before you<sup>saww</sup>, and they<sup>asws</sup> are the treasurers upon My<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge from after you<sup>saww</sup>”’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> has informed me<sup>saww</sup> of their<sup>asws</sup> names and the names of their<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup>’’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from mmd al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Shu‘ayb from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu Hamza who has said that he hear Imam abu Ja’far (a.s.)

say the following. “The Holy Prophet (s.a.) has said that Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has said, “My authority is completely established among the unfortunate ones of your followers. Those who would refuse to acknowledge the Divine authority of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) the his successors, (they have rejected My authority). Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and his successors have with your traditions and the traditions of the prophets before you. They are the treasurers of My knowledge after you.
The Holy Prophet (s.a.) then said, “ Jibril (Gabrael) has informed me of the successors of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and the names of their fathers.”
